sources.text:
## 3. Resolutions

The Board approved a share buy-back programme of up to EUR 13.5m.

The Board approved the appointment of Nordic Assurance Services as external quality auditor for a further three years.

The next meeting is scheduled for 20 January 2026.

sources.title: Board of Directors - Minutes Q2 2025
sources.text:
## 3. Resolutions

The Board approved the opening of a sales office in Stockholm in Q3 2026.

The Board noted the ISO 9001 surveillance audit passed with zero major findings.

The next meeting is scheduled for 21 October 2025.

sources.title: Board of Directors - Minutes Q3 2025
sources.text:
## Board of Directors - Minutes Q3 2025

Strictly confidential

## 1. Attendance and quorum

Meeting held on 21 October 2025 at Tampere Works, Finland. Present: Maria Peltoniemi, Margareta Lindqvist (Chair), Henrik Aalto, Dr. Ines Carvalho, Pieter van Dam, Valdemar Peltonen. Also in attendance: Ilari Pesonen (COO) and Anne Laakkonen (General Counsel, secretary to the board). Quorum was confirmed.

The minutes of the previous meeting were approved without amendment.

sources.title: Board of Directors - Minutes Q3 2025
sources.text:
## 2. Financial performance

The CFO reported Q3 FY2025 revenue of EUR 102.7 million against a budget of EUR 103.6 million, with an adjusted EBITDA margin of 15.1% and cash of EUR 50.6 million.

Order intake for the quarter was EUR 109.6 million, giving a book-to-bill ratio of 1.07.

| KPI | Q3 FY2025 | Budget |
|---|---|---|
| Revenue | EUR 102.7m | EUR 103.6m |
| EBITDA margin | 15.1% | 14.5% |
| LTIFR | 0.75 | 0.70 |
| On-time delivery | 92.6% | 93.0% |

The Board requested a cybersecurity maturity assessment following the identity provider outage.

The Board approved the 2026 long-term incentive plan for the executive team.

The next meeting is scheduled for 28 April 2026.

sources.title: Project Nordlys - Acquisition Memo
sources.text:
## Project Nordlys - Acquisition Memo

Strictly confidential - insider list

## 1. Transaction overview

Project Nordlys is the proposed acquisition of 100% of Kestrel Fluid Controls Oy, a Finnish manufacturer of smart valve actuators with FY2025 revenue of EUR 37.8 million and 186 employees.

Indicative enterprise value: EUR 73.8 million, equal to 11.2x FY2025 EBITDA. Financing from existing cash and a EUR 40m term loan.

sources.text:
## Strategic Plan 2026-2028

Board approved - confidential

## 1. Vision

By 2028 Halvorsen Industrial Systems will be the most reliable European supplier of engineered pumping systems, with recurring service and digital revenue representing 25% of group sales.

sources.title: Strategic Plan 2026-2028
sources.text:
## 3. Strategic initiatives

Initiative 1 - SmartFlow digital services: owner Ritva Soininen, budget EUR 9.5m, target 4,000 connected pumps by 2027.

Initiative 2 - Footprint optimisation: owner Ilari Pesonen, consolidate machining from Brno into Gdansk Assembly by Q2 2027, saving EUR 6.1m per year.

Initiative 3 - Nordic growth: owner Jarmo Pesonen, open Stockholm sales office and grow Nordic revenue by 40%.

Initiative 4 - Project Nordlys: owner Maria Peltoniemi, bolt-on acquisition in valve automation (see confidential memo).

Initiative 5 - Talent: owner Petteri Hartikainen, reduce voluntary attrition from 9.8% to below 7%.

sources.text:
## 4. Travel and Expenses

Business travel must be booked through the corporate travel portal. Employees should choose the most economical option that meets the business need.

The meal per diem for domestic business travel is EUR 64 per day. The meal per diem for international business travel is EUR 95 per day.

Economy class must be booked for all flights shorter than 6 hours. Hotel accommodation is capped at EUR 210 per night outside capital cities.

Expense claims must be submitted within 30 days of the expense being incurred. Use of a private car for business is reimbursed at EUR 0.42 per kilometre.
